projects.name: Student GPA Calculator
projects.summary: Adds up subject grades and credit hours to calculate a semester GPA.
projects.problem: Students often calculate GPA by hand and make mistakes with credit weighting.
projects.details: Runs entirely in the browser. Uses a common 4.0 grade scale, so check it against your own university's grading scale.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.summary: This website: portfolio, online CV, services page and free tools, hosted free on GitHub Pages.
projects.problem: Recruiters and clients need one place to see who I am, what I am learning and what I can build.
projects.details: A static website with no backend. Project, blog and settings content lives in JSON files that I edit through a private admin page, which saves changes directly to GitHub.

projects.name: Percentage Calculator
projects.summary: Three quick calculations: percent of a number, what percent one number is of another, and percent change.
projects.problem: Everyday percentage questions are easy to get wrong under time pressure.
projects.details: Browser-only calculator with three modes. No data leaves your device.

projects.name: Age Calculator
projects.summary: Works out exact age in years, months and days, plus days until the next birthday.
projects.problem: Forms and applications often ask for an exact age on a given date.
projects.details: Handles month lengths and leap years with plain JavaScript date maths.

projects.name: Word and Character Counter
projects.summary: Live word, character, sentence and paragraph counts with a reading-time estimate.
projects.problem: Assignments, applications and posts often have strict word or character limits.
projects.details: Counts update as you type. Text is never uploaded anywhere.

projects.name: Job Application Tracker
projects.summary: Keeps a list of applications with status, date and notes, saved in your own browser.
projects.problem: Job hunters lose track of where they applied and what happened next.
projects.details: First version stores data only in the browser you use (no account, no server). CSV export is included. Syncing across devices is planned for later.

projects.name: Student Management System
projects.summary: A small system to record students, courses and marks.
projects.problem: Small institutes often track student records in scattered spreadsheets.
projects.details: Planned. Will be built after I finish learning SQL and basic backend development.

projects.name: Expense Tracker
projects.summary: Log daily spending and see totals by category.
projects.problem: Students on a budget struggle to see where their money goes.
projects.details: Planned. Will start as a browser-only app and may get accounts later.

projects.name: Weather and API Dashboard
projects.summary: Shows the weather for a chosen city using a free public API.
projects.problem: Practice project for calling REST APIs and handling errors and loading states.
projects.details: Planned. This is my main practice project for working with REST APIs.

projects.name: AI Study Assistant
projects.summary: A study helper that summarises notes and creates practice questions.
projects.problem: Turning long lecture notes into revision material takes hours.
projects.details: Planned. Needs a small server-side proxy to keep API keys private, so it will come after the basics.
